text:
Vik S.: opened a PR to add guardrail examples, schema-validator tests, and clearer parser guidance for function/tool calling and structured output: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5230. looking for reviewers on schema samples and CI check changes.
Anya R.: nice. which pages are you adding/changing?
Vik S.: new docs/guides/structured-output/guardrails.md and examples/schema_validator/ with compact and expanded examples. also a small CI job that runs ajv/ajv-cli against the example outputs so we catch schema drift.
Owen D.: question: which JSON Schema version are we targeting? upstream libs vary.
Vik S.: target 2020-12 for new schemas; added a note in the PR explaining compatibility. we'll add a small validator shim in CI to use ajv with 2020-12 support.
Anya R.: please include an example for union types (oneOf) where response.payload can be a string or an object; docs team keeps tripping over parsing heuristics.
Vik S.: added both a simple and an edgecase example. snippet from canonical guide kept minimal:
```json
{
  "action": "lookup_invoice",
  "args": { "invoice_id": "inv_202" },
  "response": { "status": "ok", "payload": {"amount": 1200} }
}
```
Owen D.: and for the not-found case you kept payload null, right? good. please add a sentence saying null means "no resource" and not an error payload.
Vik S.: yup, added: "payload may be null to indicate the absence of a resource (analogous to HTTP 204); treat as no-data, not an error)."
build-bot: link-checker: 11 broken links found in docs/guides/structured-output. CI job #4021.
Anya R.: i'll triage anchors and add redirects where external links exist. don't want to break public links.
validator-bot: schema-validate: ran ajv on examples/schema_validator/; 2 failures (oneOf example missing discriminator, nullable predicate not explicit). See CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/5230/schema-results
Vik S.: thanks bot. i'll push fixes: add explicit discriminator for oneOf and use {"type": ["object","null"]} for nullable payloads per ajv.
Owen D.: small SDK note: the snippets in JS should use client.callAction(...); in Python client.call_action(...). older SDKs may still use invoke/tool_call so include a backcompat blurb.
Anya R.: also discovered Hugo renders indented triple-backticks oddly. removed leading indentation from all fenced blocks in the PR.
Vik S.: blocker list before merge: 1) schema-validate green, 2) link-check green, 3) markdown-lint green, 4) a short interop note for SDKs.
validator-bot: schema-validate: OK after fixes. link-checker: 0 failures. markdown-lint: OK. preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-5230
Anya R.: quick editorial pass done, left one tiny wording nit about "discriminator" wording.
Owen D.: reviewed interop bits for Go; added a short adapter showing mapping null -> nil and oneOf -> interface parsing.
Vik S.: merged! :rocket: thanks everyone. will follow up with a small postmortem capturing the CI checks we added for future spec churn.
